name: Bitstamp Transaction History (CSV, RFC 4180)
description: Bitstamp transaction history (bitstamp.net: profile > History > Transaction history > Open export options > CSV 'RFC 4180 (new)'). Header ID, Account, Type, Subtype, Datetime, Amount, Amount currency, Value, Value currency, Rate, Rate currency, Fee, Fee currency, Order ID. Datetime is UTC (ISO, e.g. '2025-01-15T10:00:00Z'). Amounts are written without sign; the direction comes from Type/Subtype. A Market row holds both sides: Amount in Amount currency (bought on Buy, sold on Sell) and Value in Value currency (the other way); the fee is booked in Fee currency; Order ID links them. Account (Main Account or a sub-account name) becomes the account. Staked/unstaked assets are booked as transfers to/from the account 'staking'. Known limits: the old export ('Type, Datetime, Account, Amount, Value, Rate, Fee, Sub Type' with amounts like '0.5 BTC') is not covered — choose the RFC 4180 format; 'Sub Account Transfer' keeps the amount's own sign (one row per side expected); type texts not listed fall to unknown.
